mapper.update: UPDATE ja_conversation_thread SET temporary_lifecycle_state='OPEN' WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND temporary_lifecycle_state IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id,temporary_lifecycle_state AS state FROM ja_conversation_thread WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND temporary_lifecycle_state IS NOT NULL

SELECT t.thread_id,t.temporary_lifecycle_state AS state FROM ja_conversation_thread t JOIN ja_conversation_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=t.thread_id WHERE t.temporary_lifecycle_state IS NOT NULL AND l.task_kind='SIDE_TASK' AND l.lifecycle='INDEPENDENT' ORDER BY t.thread_id

WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id,depth) AS ( SELECT thread_id,0 FROM ja_conversation_thread WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND temporary_lifecycle_state IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id,t.depth+1 FROM ja_conversation_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id) SELECT thread_id FROM tree ORDER BY depth,thread_id
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE tree(thread_id) AS ( SELECT thread_id FROM ja_conversation_thread WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND temporary_lifecycle_state IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT l.child_thread_id FROM ja_conversation_lineage l JOIN tree t ON l.parent_thread_id=t.thread_id) UPDATE ja_conversation_thread SET temporary_lifecycle_state='CLOSING' WHERE thread_id IN(SELECT thread_id FROM tree)
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(thread_id) AS ( SELECT #{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id FROM ja_conversation_lineage l JOIN ancestors a ON l.child_thread_id=a.thread_id) SELECT t.thread_id FROM ja_conversation_thread t JOIN ancestors a ON a.thread_id=t.thread_id WHERE t.temporary_lifecycle_state='CLOSING' ORDER BY t.thread_id LIMIT 1
